evidenceRule: Run two complete weeks and until Console reports sufficient evidence. No fixed impression threshold. Keep control if inconclusive.

sequence.control: Play five-card poker offline. Hold, forge or bail against the dealer and table.
sequence.challenger: Face the dealer in five-card poker. Offline play, no ads and play-money chips.

allocation: One challenger against control; change one element at a time. Avoid simultaneous listing updates in en-US while a test runs.
target: 20% relative increase is a planning target, not a forecast; a 100% baseline cannot improve by 20% relatively.
rollback: Restore the winning/control files from the dated backup and log the decision.
